title_en: Jobs (7/20): A Programmer Against the Deadline
note_en: 又……又…… joins two qualities that are both true at once: 又快又好地完成功能 "deliver features both fast and well," 又累又忙 "exhausting and hectic." English just says "both A and B," but in Chinese 又 is repeated before each adjective, and when the pair describes how an action is done, 地 links it to the verb that follows.
